name: One-Time Secret Tunnel
description: One-time, never-stored, out-of-band credential pass-through. The agent never sees the value.

publicUrl.label: Public base URL
publicUrl.help: Public HTTPS base of the gateway (your own reverse proxy or Tailscale Funnel URL). When set, no tunnel is started and the provider-blind transport is used. Leave blank to use the default on-demand Cloudflare quick tunnel.

detectTailscale.label: Detect Tailscale
detectTailscale.help: Opt-in: derive the base URL from this node's tailnet DNS name. Only enable if Tailscale Serve/Funnel for the gateway port is actually configured — detection alone does not make the link publicly reachable.

tunnel.label: Fallback tunnel
tunnel.help: cloudflared (default): when no publicUrl/Tailscale reachability exists, request_secret starts an ephemeral Cloudflare quick tunnel that lives only while a link is open. Requires the cloudflared binary on PATH. Note: quick tunnels terminate TLS at Cloudflare's edge. Set off to disable.
